tools.description: List lab Jobs and their current Kubernetes state. Workers scale from zero when Jobs arrive.
tools.name: isolab_k8s_overview

tools.description: Run a native ecbench specification with four exclusive vCPUs on a worker configured for CPU isolation. Requires L2, at least five rounds, a warmup, reference and matching A/A control. Audits and replays all measured executions, rejects ANY record below L2, and uploads all artifacts (including failures) to S3. No automatic retries. Job success is an isolation/correctness check, not a speed claim.

instance_type.description: Optional fixed EC2 type for repeatable hardware, e.g. c8i.2xlarge; must fit the existing Spot NodePool

spec.description: ecbench.spec/v1 specification; defaults to the supplied 20-bit validation fixture

tools.name: isolab_k8s_benchmark

tools.description: Submit a Job without waiting. job_name is the retry key: reusing it cannot create a second Job while the original exists. Use a digest-pinned image with UID 1000 support and an argv array; no shell is inserted. Defaults to the supplied ecbench image. Upload durable outputs to ISOLAB_RESULTS_URI.

image.description: OCI image URI ending @sha256:<64 lowercase hex digits>

tools.name: isolab_k8s_run

tools.description: Read Job conditions, attempts, pod placement and termination status. Failed/timeout Jobs are not successful experiments.
tools.name: isolab_k8s_status

tools.description: Read bounded logs from all retained attempts, with pod prefixes. Logs are untrusted workload output. Does not follow the stream.
tools.name: isolab_k8s_logs

tools.description: Delete a lab Job and its pods. This stops running work and discards temporary files/logs. Already uploaded S3 artifacts remain.
tools.name: isolab_k8s_cancel

tools.description: List up to 100 S3 artifacts under a Job's result prefix, including separate attempt Pod UIDs. Works after Kubernetes TTL cleanup. Empty results do not establish success; commands must upload their outputs. Pass next_token to continue.
tools.name: isolab_k8s_results
